text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Are you having another meeting for the 
'Beauty Dream Cup' today?"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Talking about the year after next, 
timing-wise♪ I'll do my very best for our 
future little rough diamonds!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The year after next... In that case, the 
incoming freshmen will have a chance to 
wear your dress as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to it. Comparing 
myself with that green fruit, that is.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I certainly hope the juniors work 
hard... hm? "With" the green fruit...?

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Ramonu-chan! Are you hoping to enter 
the BDC once again?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Even childish roughness is an element of 
love. I'll blend it in, understand it... 
and savor it.

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! That hunger, that beauty! All you 
rough diamonds out there... do your best! 
Competing against her will be a wonderful 
experience!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! Why don't you join in too, Air 
Groove-chan? Enter as an impenetrable wall 
for our juniors to overcome!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ramonu-senpai is more than enough for that 
role. If I am to participate, let me do so 
in a different form... playing the part of 
'Expectation.'

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
As someone with experience: scolding, 
praising, and helping those who follow get 
back up to inspire them. Yes, there should 
be someone around who acknowledges their 
hard work.

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Beaaautiful!! That's right, watching over 
our juniors with love makes them stronger♪

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Passion is "love," and guidance is "love" 
too! As the organizer of the BDC, it seems 
I still have much to learn...♪
